items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 'Equipment' (mass noun, accepted as plural); #add 'Add equipment' is the only filled primary button, #export is a white outlined secondary button. Audit headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: A four-card KPI row (Total equipment 48, Operational 39, Under maintenance 6, Inspections due 8) sits above the table. The table body is also empty in the 1440x900 screenshot, with only the header row visible. Search, location select and an 'Inspection due' toggle are present.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: render() never sorts; the rows keep array order (EQ-001, EQ-002 ...) and the 'Next inspection' header only has a static arrow. No rows render in the screenshot at all.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Only overdue rows get a text badge ('Overdue'). Due-soon rows get just a 4px dot (span.w-1.h-1.rounded-full.bg-[#c6a360]) and amber text colour, so they are marked by colour alone. No rows are visible in the screenshot anyway.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: The code would format dates as '05 Nov 2026' via date() and show codes like 'EQ-001' in the equipment cell. But no rows render, so none of it is visible. The audit reports pageErrors: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase')" and rows.single/double/multi are all 0.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Tabs 'All equipment 48', 'Operational 39', 'Under maintenance 6', 'Offline 3'. They are status counts, with no overdue count, but they meet the status-tab criterion.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: No rows render, so single-line rows cannot be confirmed (audit rows all 0). The row code has a chevron button with aria-label 'View ... details', which is only one control per row, but it is not visible.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: #empty says 'No equipment matches your filters.' with a #clear 'Clear filters' button, but it stays hidden in the screenshot while the table is blank. There is no first-use empty state, no loading state and no error or retry state in the markup or script.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: The audit has a text-contrast error x37: breadcrumb 3.06:1, header date 3.53:1, subtitle p 3.37:1, button#add 4.46:1, sidebar section label 3.47:1. Status badges use light-on-pale colours such as #b38a40 on #fff5e6. Target size shows 0 violations.

notes: The page crashes on load. The audit logs a TypeError ('toLowerCase' of undefined), and the screenshot shows an empty table body with no rows, so most row-level criteria fail on observed behaviour. Audit score is 62/100. The 'Equipment' title is a mass noun, so the plural-title pass is lenient. Tells: 'WORKSPACE' tracked caps label and uppercase table headers; the promo card reading 'Keep your plant moving'; the gear and sparkle glyphs used as icons; a dark navy sidebar (#192537) with a periwinkle accent (#7594ff, #4e6ee7).
